headline: Dexco Reports 142 Million Reais Loss in Third Quarter
summary: Brazilian company Dexco reported a net loss of 142 million reais for the third quarter of 2026, reversing a profit of 14.2 million reais in the same period last year. The loss was driven by factory decommissioning costs.
why: Dexco is a major manufacturer of construction materials and home products in Brazil. Its results reflect broader trends in the Brazilian construction and housing market.
